description: Describe the workspace: root, provider and model, validator, policy source, registered studies, active study and session id. Call it first when you need to know what this corpus is; it reads no file contents.
name: workspace_info

description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the workspace. Each line comes back as '<number>  <text>'; the number and the two spaces are not part of the file, so never copy them into edit_file. Long results stop early and end with the start_line to continue from; lines over 2000 characters are cut. Files over 1 MiB are refused (use grep). Secret files are denied by policy.
name: read_file

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return (1-2000).

start_line.description: First line to return (1-based). Use the next_start_line of a truncated read to continue.

description: List workspace paths matching a glob (directories end with '/'). '*' matches the top level only; use '**/*' or 'corpus/**/*.md' to recurse. VCS, virtualenv, cache and dependency directories are skipped, and paths the read policy denies are counted in omitted_by_policy, not listed. truncated: true means more paths match than limit.
name: list_files

limit.description: Return at most this many paths (1-2000).

pattern.description: Glob relative to the workspace root.

description: Search text files with a Python regular expression; each match is 'path:line: text' (text cut at 300 characters). Case-insensitive unless case_sensitive is true. Searches at most 5000 files and skips files over 1 MiB: when search_complete is false, count 0 is not evidence of absence; narrow the glob. Stops after 10 s; use fixed_strings for literal text.
name: grep

fixed_strings.description: Treat pattern as literal text, not a regex.

glob.description: Which files to search, relative to the root.

max_matches.description: Return at most this many matching lines (1-1000).

pattern.description: Regular expression (or literal text with fixed_strings).

description: List the studies registered in corpus/studies/INDEX.md, optionally filtered by track or status. Use study_show for one study's card.
name: study_list

description: Show one registered study card: its frontmatter and body.
name: study_show

study_id.description: The study id from study_list, exactly as listed.

description: Run the corpus's own validator (Node) and return its JSON report. Run it after edits and before claiming the corpus is consistent; a failing report lists each error with its file.
name: validate

release.description: Pass --release to the validator, which runs the release checks the corpus defines.

description: Ask what the policy would decide for an action before trying it: allow, ask (needs the user's approval), deny or hard_deny, with the rule. It changes nothing and grants nothing. Use it to explain a block, not to look for another route around one.
name: policy_check

action.description: read, write or edit a path; shell a command; validate the corpus.

resource.description: Workspace-relative path, or the command line for shell.

description: Append a short observation to the session ledger (hash-chained, kept after the session). Use it for decisions and findings worth auditing later, not for chat. At most 4000 characters are kept.
name: session_note

description: Create a file or replace it with the full new content (up to 2 MiB). Prefer edit_file for changes to an existing file. Writes are checked against the policy: some paths ask the user (they see a diff), some are always denied (.git, .panda, the validator). Content must not contain the [redacted] marker that stands for a hidden secret.
name: write_file

description: Replace an exact string in an existing UTF-8 file. old_string must match the file text exactly (without read_file's line-number prefix) and occur once, unless replace_all is true; include surrounding lines to make it unique. Line endings are kept. Checked against the policy like write_file.
name: edit_file

old_string.description: Exact text to replace; must not be empty.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of exactly one.

description: Run one program with an argv array. There is no shell: pipes, globs, redirection, '&&' and variables are not interpreted (pass each argument as its own string). The environment is cleaned of credentials. Most commands ask the user first; destructive ones (force-push, rm -rf, git reset --hard) are always denied. stdout and stderr are each cut at about 15000 characters.
name: run_shell

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the root.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the command after this many seconds.

description: List evidence records from corpus/evidence/evidence.jsonl (id, study, track, source path and line, license). total counts the records that match the filter.
name: evidence_list

limit.description: Return at most this many records (1-1000).

description: Show one full evidence record from corpus/evidence/evidence.jsonl.
name: evidence_show

evidence_id.description: The evidence id from evidence_list, exactly as listed.

description: List claims from the frontmatter of corpus/claims/*.md, with their evidence and number ids. Cards the policy hides, links and oversized cards are counted (omitted_by_policy, omitted_links, omitted_too_large), not listed.
name: claim_list

limit.description: Return at most this many claims (1-1000).

description: Show one claim card: frontmatter and body (body cut at 8000 characters).
name: claim_show

claim_id.description: The claim id from claim_list, exactly as listed.

description: List the numbers in corpus/numbers.json with their value and evidence link. Cite a number by its number_id.
name: number_list

limit.description: Return at most this many numbers (1-1000).

description: Show one full number record from corpus/numbers.json.
name: number_show

number_id.description: The number id from number_list, exactly as listed.
